hook: AI gave you a 7-step framework when you just needed a yes or no.
caption:
AI gave you a 7-step framework when you just needed a yes or no.

You asked: "Should I send that email to my client?"

AI returned: A numbered list. With headers. And a conclusion paragraph.

You didn't need a framework. You needed a friend who knows your communication style to say "yeah, send it — just cut the last line."

This is the core problem with generic AI. It doesn't know if you're a decisive executor who wants a one-word answer, or a deep-thinker who actually wants to pressure-test the decision.

So it defaults to... everything. Maximum coverage. Zero personalization.

BootFile fixes this by mapping how you actually think — not just what you ask.

Are you someone who processes out loud and needs pushback? Tell it that.
Do you hate preamble and want the answer in the first sentence? Tell it that.
Do you make gut decisions and just need validation, not analysis? Tell it that.

When AI knows your thinking style, "should I send this email" gets a real answer.

Not a deliverable.
